id: title:Gilbert09:treat pooler shutdown as a transient db error

review.posthog_relevance: Adds database connection pooler error handling and recovery capability.
review.reason: Adds a recognized error message and test case for the PostgreSQL connection pooler shutdown state, allowing PostHog to distinguish this specific failure from generic exceptions. This could improve database connection reliability and recovery, but the broader implementation and recovery behavior are not supplied.
review.uncertainty: Only supplied hunk IDs are available; no other hunks, file context, or surrounding implementation are provided, so broader change assessment and tier assignment are not possible.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are available; no other hunks, file context, or surrounding implementation are provided, so broader change assessment and tier assignment are not possible.

observations.behavior: Adds a new recognized error message and its corresponding test case.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog's database connection handling to distinguish and potentially recover or report gracefully when the connection pooler (pgbouncer/pgcat) is draining and rejecting connections, rather than treating it as an unhandled exception or generic failure.
